_comment: Vanilla's composter blockstate with our models in it, and multipart for the same reason: the
frame is one part that is always drawn, and the contents are a single quad whose height is the
only thing that changes. As variants each level would be a full copy of the five-element frame.
Levels 1-7 are loose kief piling up on the screen; level 8 is the pressed slab, and it is a
different texture rather than a taller pile because pressing is a real step and the block is
the only place it can be shown.
Heights follow vanilla's composter exactly (3,5,7,9,11,13,15) so the fill reads at the same
rate players already know from a block that looks like this one.
